POST $dir.newAccount
payload {}
$code == 201
$header.Location ~ ^https://magnolia.test/acme/account/
$body.status == valid
capture acct = $header.Location

POST-as-GET $account.url
$body.status == valid

# A second newAccount with the same key returns the existing account.
POST $dir.newAccount
payload {}
$code == 200
$header.Location == $acct
$body.status == valid

POST $dir.newAccount
payload {"onlyReturnExisting": true}
$code == 200
$header.Location == $acct

# The original account URL still works after both lookups.
POST-as-GET $acct
$body.status == valid

POST $acct
payload {}
$body.status == valid

# onlyReturnExisting with an unknown key does not create an account.
POST $dir.newAccount as account2
payload {"onlyReturnExisting": true}
error == accountDoesNotExist

POST $dir.newAccount as account2
payload {}
$code == 201
$header.Location != $account.url

# An account update signed by a different account is rejected.
POST $account.url as account2
payload {"contact": ["mailto:account2@example.org"]}
error == unauthorized

POST-as-GET $account.url as account2
error == unauthorized

# A kid for an account that does not exist.
POST-as-GET $account.url
sign kid
sign header kid "https://magnolia.test/acme/account/does-not-exist"
error == accountDoesNotExist

# newAccount requires an embedded JWK, everything else a kid.
POST $dir.newAccount
sign kid
payload {}
error == malformed

POST-as-GET $account.url
sign jwk
error == malformed

# Malformed payloads.
POST-as-GET $dir.newAccount as account3
error == malformed

POST $dir.newAccount as account3
payload {
error == malformed

POST $account.url
payload {
error == malformed

# Valid JSON with the wrong field types is also rejected.
POST $dir.newAccount as account3
payload {"onlyReturnExisting": "true"}
error == malformed

POST $account.url
payload {"status": 42}
error == malformed

# Failed requests neither create an account nor change the existing one.
POST $dir.newAccount as account3
payload {"onlyReturnExisting": true}
error == accountDoesNotExist

POST-as-GET $acct
$body.status == valid

# Every ML-DSA parameter set is accepted as an account key.
key account65 ML-DSA-65

POST $dir.newAccount as account65
payload {}
$code == 201

key account87 ML-DSA-87

POST $dir.newAccount as account87
payload {}
$code == 201

POST-as-GET $account65.url as account65
$body.status == valid

POST-as-GET $account87.url as account87
$body.status == valid
